ICE Hockey League Top Scorers

Source: R/esports.R
icehl_top_scorers.Rd

Skater scoring leaderboard of one competition season.

Wraps GET https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/icehl.hokejovyzapis.cz/league-top-scorers/{season}/{league_id}.json of the ICE Hockey League eSports bucket. Example: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/icehl.hokejovyzapis.cz/league-top-scorers/2026/1.json. Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/27); every request waits at least one second after the last one to the same host.

Usage

icehl_top_scorers(season, league_id = 1L, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

season

Season by its END year (2027 = 2026/27). The bucket keys seasons by their START year; the wrapper requests season - 1.

league_id

Competition id. 1 = ICE Hockey League, regular season and playoffs in one file (split them by league_part_name); 2 = pre-season (2025/26 on).

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON body (a nested list).

Value

A tibble::tibble() with one row per row of the file (zero rows, carrying the documented columns, for an empty frame); the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE. Columns:

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerPlayer id (player key space, per bucket, stable across games and seasons); joins to playerId in rosters, events, boxscores and leaderboards.
namecharacterPlayer first name.
surnamecharacterPlayer last name.
photocharacterPlayer photo URL; null when none.
birthdatecharacterBirth date YYYY-MM-DD.
team_idintegerTeam id (team key space, per bucket, stable across seasons); joins to league-matches home.id / guest.id and the {team_id} path param.
team_namecharacterTeam display name.
team_shortcutcharacterThree-letter team code.
goalsintegerGoals the player scored in the league-season.
assistsintegerAssists credited to the player in the league-season.
pointsintegerPoints, goals + assists.
shotsintegerShots on goal.
penalty_minutesintegerPenalty minutes assessed to the player in the league-season.

Errors

Signalled as classed conditions: fastRhockey_no_data when the bucket has no such key (S3 404 NoSuchKey: unknown season, competition, match or team) or the file holds no rows (an unplayed game, an empty shot shell); fastRhockey_asset_fetch for any other non-2xx answer (403 AccessDenied), a connection failure after retries, an empty or unreadable 200 body, an error envelope, a body of the wrong shape, or a body for another season or game; fastRhockey_bad_request for an HTTP 400/422 or an invalid argument. All three also inherit fastRhockey_error. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

See also

ICE Hockey League (the league site whose widgets read this public eSports bucket)

Other ICE Hockey League eSports functions: icehl_faceoffs(), icehl_game_center(), icehl_game_info(), icehl_goalie_box(), icehl_league_part_player_stats(), icehl_pbp(), icehl_player_box(), icehl_schedule(), icehl_shots(), icehl_standings(), icehl_team_player_stats()

  try(icehl_top_scorers(season = 2027, league_id = 1))
